1478453789.headline: Choose a vehicle. Find your own route.
1478453789.summary: Explore an open driving world, take on missions and grow your vehicle collection.
paragraphs: Find a new route through the city, discover shortcuts or head straight for your next mission. Car Games gives you the freedom to explore a driving world and put a growing collection of vehicles on the road.

On iPhone and iPad, drive online with other players and choose from more than 50 trucks, pickups, buses and classic cars. Complete missions for rewards, buy and upgrade vehicles, or challenge a city boss to a race. PlayStation and Xbox controller support gives you another way to take the wheel.

On Android, explore with cars, buses and trucks, take on driving and racing missions, and buy and upgrade your vehicles. The Android edition includes an offline mode for driving without an internet connection.

iOS: vehicle collection, upgrades and city-boss races.
iOS: PlayStation and Xbox controller support advertised.
Android: open-world driving, vehicle upgrades and offline mode advertised.

faqs.question: Can I use a controller?
faqs.answer: The iPhone and iPad edition supports PlayStation and Xbox controllers.

faqs.question: Can I drive offline?
faqs.answer: Choose the Android edition for offline driving. The iPhone and iPad edition features online open-world multiplayer driving.

faqs.question: Is Car Games free to download?
faqs.answer: The iPhone and iPad app is free to download and offers optional auto-renewing VIP subscriptions. The Android app includes ads and in-app purchases. See your store for current prices and subscription terms.

paragraphs: Take your car to the starting line and race other players in online multiplayer battles. Racing Clash is built around head-to-head competition: choose your ride, enter a race and chase the next finish.

Choose Racing Clash when you want a race against another driver. For open-world exploration and driving missions, try Car Games.

6670452785.headline: Time the jump. Stick the landing.
6670452785.summary: Ride ramps and obstacle tracks, balancing speed and control through each bike challenge.
paragraphs: Hit the ramp, balance your bike in the air and aim for a clean landing. Motorcycle Games: Bike Race brings jumps, obstacles and arcade riding into a session built around timing and control.

On iPhone and iPad, ride desert tracks with ramps, bridges and hazards, then return to timed levels to chase a faster finish. Simple controls make it easy to start, while tricky landings give you something to work on.
On Android, find the game as Motorcycle Race: Bike Game. Ride motorcycle levels with ramps, jumps and obstacles, using simple controls to manage your timing, balance and landings.

faqs.answer: Take on ramps, jumps and obstacles with simple controls. The iPhone and iPad edition also includes desert tracks, bridges and timed levels for chasing a faster finish.

1610019963.headline: Clear the jam, one clever move at a time.
1610019963.summary: Clear crowded parking lots, open a path for each car and unlock new skins as you progress.
paragraphs: Work out which cars can leave first and open a path through a crowded parking lot. Parking Games turns the parking jam into a colorful 3D puzzle, with increasingly challenging layouts and new skins to unlock as you progress.
Take on more than 10,000 parking puzzles on iPhone and iPad. Play offline on iPhone, iPad and Android, so you can work through your next jam without Wi-Fi.
The Android edition also includes hints and selectable difficulty. Choose Parking Games when you want to plan the order of your moves and enjoy the satisfaction of an empty lot.

faqs.question: What kind of game is Parking Games?
faqs.answer: It is a 3D parking-jam and unblock puzzle. Plan which cars can leave first, clear the lot and unlock skins as you progress.

faqs.question: Can I play without Wi-Fi?
faqs.answer: Yes. Play the parking puzzles offline on iPhone, iPad and Android. An internet connection is needed for store purchases and other online services.

faqs.question: Are there hints and difficulty choices?
faqs.answer: The Android edition includes hints and selectable difficulty.
